voice.welcome: Welcome to the silly word workshop!
voice.swapIntro: Change one sound and watch a new word pop out.
voice.trailIntro: Follow the word trail, one tiny change at a time.
voice.labIntro: Mix the letters in the word lab and discover what they make.
voice.tapHint: Tap a letter slot to try a new sound.
voice.magicHint: Need a little magic? Tap the magic swap.
voice.sillyWord: A silly word! I love it!
voice.trailComplete: You reached the end of the trail!
voice.modeComplete: Mode complete! What a word wizard!
voice.nudge1: Listen for the sound that changes.
voice.nudge2: Try another letter. Your idea might be wonderfully silly.
voice.again: Let us try one more time!

voice.swap2: Change the middle sound: hat can become hot!
voice.swap3: Try a new ending sound for hot.
voice.swap4: Swap the first sound in dog.
voice.swap5: Change the middle sound in log.
voice.swap6: Swap the first sound in pig.
voice.trailHat: Change cat to hat. Tap the sound that changes.
voice.trailHot: Change hat to hot. Tap the sound that changes.
voice.trailHog: Change hot to hog. Tap the sound that changes.
voice.trailDog: Change hog to dog. Tap the sound that changes.
voice.trailMug: Change bug to mug. Tap the sound that changes.
voice.trailRug: Change mug to rug. Tap the sound that changes.
voice.trailRag: Change rug to rag. Tap the sound that changes.
voice.trailRat: Change rag to rat. Tap the sound that changes.
